procedure: cargo test --locked --workspace (cw-ai: thirty rivals and five archetypes, one slot per four weeks, at most four strategic actions, token player stake does not freeze a rival, postcard reload proposes identical commands, strike answer outside the slot, seasonal farm borrows, demand-limited firm cuts, contractor needs queued projects); cw-cli sweep archetype telemetry in evidence/balance/*.json.
limitations: Scores are integer proxies of 52-week cash benefit, not forecasts. Rivals do not lobby, issue equity or bonds, or bid for player-controlled companies. Scheduler state derives from the saved tick and stable handles rather than a stored queue.
